title: Why Prices End in 99 (Left-Digit Effect)
description:
Why do almost all prices end in 99? It's called the left-digit effect, and here's how to use it in your own pricing.

Follow MarketOpsTips for a quick marketing tip every morning.

#marketing #pricing #shorts

beats.say: There's a reason almost every price ends in 99.
We read numbers from left to right, and the first digit sticks in our head.
So 399 feels closer to 300 than to 400, even though it's just one rupee less.
Researchers call this the left-digit effect.
Use it on everyday products. But for luxury items, round prices like 4,000 often feel more premium.
So, which price would you pick?
